### Who Do You Say I Am? - The Crosswalk Devotional - January 8
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/who-do-you-say-i-am-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Matthew 16:15
Points:
- What a person believes about Jesus' identity is the foundation of Christian faith.
- Jesus proved His divinity by fulfilling prophecies, sacrificing His life on the cross, and rising from the dead.
- Recognizing Christ as both fully God and fully man is essential to receiving His gift of salvation.
- In times of spiritual disillusionment or questioning, returning to who Jesus is restores a firm faith.

### Who Do You Say He Is? - Greg Laurie Devotion - March 31, 2025
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-march-31-2025.html
Passage: Matthew 16:15-16
Points:
- Extensive fulfillment of Old Testament prophecy demonstrates that Jesus is the true Messiah.
- Acknowledging Christ cannot remain an intellectual curiosity; it demands a personal response deep within.
- Trusting who Jesus is leads believers to emulate Him, prioritize His kingdom, and proclaim Him.
- Standing courageously for Christ may carry earthly costs, but God will bless and reward that faithfulness.
